name: EquipmentShare.com Inc Class A Common Stock
description: EquipmentShare.com Inc is a vertically integrated platform that combines proprietary technology, a connected equipment fleet, and a nationwide footprint to serve the construction industry. The company operates its business through the following reportable segments: Equipment Rental and Services Operations, comprised of recurring activity performed at full-service branch locations, such as equipment rentals and related services, and sales of parts, supplies, and maintenance services to construction contractors and others. Equipment Sales, sales of new or used equipment made at any of the branch locations and dealership sites, including equipment sales to participants in the OWN Program.
